_comment: EXAMPLE dev parameters for main.bicep. Copy to infra/main.dev.parameters.json (the name scripts/deploy.sh and scripts/set-secrets.sh read) and replace every <...> value with your own. No SQL password lives here: the SQL server is Entra-only and the web + Functions apps authenticate with their managed identities.
_comment_baseName: Lowercase letters and digits only, at most 12 characters (it is embedded in storage-account and Key Vault names, which cap at 24). Drives every resource name: rg-<baseName>-dev, <baseName>-web-<suffix>, <baseName>-db, and so on.
_comment_customDomain: Informational: the hostname you will bind AFTER the deploy, once its DNS CNAME exists (see README 'Getting started'). Leave empty if you will use the default *.azurewebsites.net host.
_comment_testMode: Dev runs in TestMode: integrations read but never write to shared upstream systems, and coordinator notifications go to the test address only.
_comment_sqlAadAdmin: An Entra (Azure AD) GROUP that administers the SQL server. Create or pick a group you are a member of, then put its display name and object id here.
